-- PATNA HIGH COURT
NOTICE
District Judge (Entry Level), Direct from Bar Exam
RESULT
Pursuant to the Order dated 11 .03.2026 passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in
Civil Appeal No. 3947 of 2020 (Rejanish K.V. versus K. Deepa & Ors.) and other
connected cases, Ms. Saleha Sabiha who is presently working as Judicial Magistrate-1-
cum-Additional Civil Judge (Jr. Div.), Begusarai is declared successful for
recommendation to the State Government for her appointment to the post of District &
Add itional Sessions Judge under the District Judge (Entry) Level, Direct from Bar Exam-
2021, w.e.f. from 10.10.2025.
Court's earlier notice dated 19.12.2024 so far as it relates to her stands modified
to the above extent.
Patna High Court, Patna
Date: 02.09.2026
By order of the Court
Registrar General
